_comment: Field help for the config editor's Form view and the Settings fields (js/cfg-help.js). Each catalog maps path patterns (`*` any key, `#` any list index, `**` the rest) to {what, change?, accepts?, default?, effect?, choices?}. Plain text; `backticks` mark code.

plan_retention.what: How many plans the hub keeps in its data directory (`plans/`). A plan is the reviewed list of file changes for one or more clients; Apply needs the plan you reviewed.
plan_retention.change: Lower keeps less on disk; a plan older than the newest N is deleted when a new plan is made, and applying it then fails (make a new plan).
plan_retention.effect: At once, and kept in the hub's database across restarts (it then wins over `HUB_PLAN_RETENTION` in the hub env file).

inbox_max_per_client.what: The most pending proposals one client may have in the memory inbox. Agents propose memories with their client token; you promote or reject them on the Inbox page.
inbox_max_per_client.change: Lower stops a busy or misbehaving agent sooner: once a client reaches the limit, its new proposals are refused until you clear some.
inbox_max_per_client.effect: At once, and kept in the hub's database across restarts (it then wins over `HUB_INBOX_MAX_PER_CLIENT` in the hub env file).

inbox_rate_per_min.what: How many inbox proposals one client may send per minute.
inbox_rate_per_min.change: Lower slows down an agent that floods the inbox; proposals over the rate are refused (HTTP 429) and the agent may try again later.
inbox_rate_per_min.effect: At once, and kept in the hub's database across restarts (it then wins over `HUB_INBOX_RATE_PER_MIN` in the hub env file).

eval_gate.what: The skill evaluation gate for normal imports (the Import page and discover). It looks at the SkillEvaluator result of the exact content being imported.
eval_gate.change: `off`: no check. `advisory`: the gate is shown, nothing is refused. `require`: a skill without an evaluation, or with a blocked gate, is refused unless you give an override reason (recorded in the audit log).
eval_gate.effect: At once, and kept in the hub's database across restarts (it then wins over `HUB_EVAL_GATE`).

eval_gate_observed.what: The same gate for skills imported from a client's observed inventory (Clients > Health > Observed), which is untrusted text taken from a live agent.
eval_gate_observed.change: Keep it at `require` unless you have a reason: the inventory can carry text an agent wrote.
eval_gate_observed.effect: At once, and kept in the hub's database across restarts.

eval_gate_min_tiers.what: The weakest evaluation that counts for the gate. `static` needs no model; `tier1` and `tier1+2` also need the LLM pass of SkillEvaluator.
eval_gate_min_tiers.change: A stronger tier means fewer skills pass until you run the deeper evaluation on them (Evaluations page).
eval_gate_min_tiers.effect: At once, and kept in the hub's database across restarts.

HUB_HOST.what: The address the hub listens on.
HUB_HOST.change: Keep it on loopback. Any other address is refused at start unless `HUB_ALLOW_NONLOOPBACK=1` is in the process environment, and then you need an authenticating reverse proxy in front.
HUB_HOST.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_PORT.what: The TCP port of the API and the UI.
HUB_PORT.change: Open the UI on the new port; the port is also part of the Host header allowlist. Clients that call the hub (agents with an inbox token) need the new URL.
HUB_PORT.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_CONTENT_DIR.what: The content git repo: skills, agents, rules, MCP servers, collections, profiles and `clients/<id>.yaml`.
HUB_CONTENT_DIR.change: The hub uses the repo at the new path; nothing is moved. Keep it outside any project an agent works in. Move an existing repo with `hubctl migrate-content --to PATH`.
HUB_CONTENT_DIR.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_DATA_DIR.what: The hub's private state: `hub.db` (keys, settings, audit), the bootstrap admin key, plans, locks, snapshots and backups (mode 0700).
HUB_DATA_DIR.change: A new path starts with empty state: new bootstrap key, no keys, no history. Copy the directory first if you move it.
HUB_DATA_DIR.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_POLICY_FILE.what: The policy floor file. It lives in the app checkout, never in content.
HUB_POLICY_FILE.change: Point it only at a reviewed floor file; the hub refuses to start when the file is missing or invalid.
HUB_POLICY_FILE.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_FRONTEND_DIR.what: Where the UI files are served from.
HUB_FRONTEND_DIR.change: Only for a moved or packaged UI; without UI files the hub serves the API only.
HUB_FRONTEND_DIR.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_GIT_BIN.what: The git program the hub runs for the content repo and git-backed operations.
HUB_GIT_BIN.change: Use an absolute path to pin a specific git.
HUB_GIT_BIN.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_GIT_TIMEOUT_S.what: Seconds a git command may run before the hub stops it.
HUB_GIT_TIMEOUT_S.change: Raise it for a slow disk or a very large content repo.
HUB_GIT_TIMEOUT_S.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_GIT_AUTHOR_NAME.what: The author name of the hub's commits in the content repo.
HUB_GIT_AUTHOR_NAME.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL.what: The author email of the hub's commits in the content repo.
HUB_GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS.what: Extra Host header values the hub accepts besides 127.0.0.1, localhost and [::1] with its port (DNS-rebinding protection).
HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS.change: Add only the name a trusted reverse proxy sends; any other Host gets 421.
HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_TRUST_LOOPBACK.what: Whether a request from loopback with no key is treated as admin.
HUB_TRUST_LOOPBACK.change: Leave it `false`. `true` makes every local process (any agent with a shell) admin without a key; the UI then shows a warning on every page.
HUB_TRUST_LOOPBACK.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_BODY_CAP_BYTES.what: The largest request body the API accepts (most routes).
HUB_BODY_CAP_BYTES.change: Bigger bodies get 413 before they are read.
HUB_BODY_CAP_BYTES.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_IMPORT_BODY_CAP_BYTES.what: The largest body for import and discover.
HUB_IMPORT_BODY_CAP_BYTES.change: Raise it for very large imports.
HUB_IMPORT_BODY_CAP_BYTES.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_MAX_SSE_CONNECTIONS.what: How many live event streams (knowledge job progress) may be open at once.
HUB_MAX_SSE_CONNECTIONS.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_SSE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_S.what: Seconds an event stream may stay idle before the hub closes it.
HUB_SSE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_S.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_MAX_CONTENT_FILE_BYTES.what: The largest single content file the hub reads or writes (an item's YAML or Markdown).
HUB_MAX_CONTENT_FILE_BYTES.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_MAX_SKILL_BYTES.what: The largest skill, all of its files together.
HUB_MAX_SKILL_BYTES.change: Bigger skills are refused at import and save.
HUB_MAX_SKILL_BYTES.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_MAX_LIVE_FILE_BYTES.what: The largest client file the planner reads from disk to compare or merge.
HUB_MAX_LIVE_FILE_BYTES.change: A larger live file blocks the plan for that file instead of being read.
HUB_MAX_LIVE_FILE_BYTES.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_KNOWLEDGE_URL.what: Where the hub's knowledge proxy finds the knowledge service.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_URL.change: The Knowledge page talks to the service at this URL, through the hub.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_URL.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY.what: The knowledge service's admin key, sent by the hub's proxy. A secret.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY.change: Without it the hub reads the key file below. Keep this env file 0600 when you set it.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_KNOWLEDGE_TOKEN.what: The older name of `HUB_KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY`. A secret.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_TOKEN.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY_FILE.what: The file the hub reads the knowledge admin key from when no key is set here (the service writes it on first start).
KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY_FILE.change: Point it at the service's `<data_dir>/admin.key` if you moved that directory.
KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY_FILE.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY_FILE.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_KNOWLEDGE_TIMEOUT_S.what: Seconds the hub waits for the knowledge service on one call.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_TIMEOUT_S.change: Raise it for slow embedding endpoints; a timed-out call fails on the Knowledge page.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_TIMEOUT_S.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_KNOWLEDGE_BODY_CAP_BYTES.what: The largest request body the hub forwards to the knowledge service.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_BODY_CAP_BYTES.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_KNOWLEDGE_RESPONSE_CAP_BYTES.what: The largest answer the hub accepts from the knowledge service.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_RESPONSE_CAP_BYTES.change: A bigger answer is cut off and the call fails.
HUB_KNOWLEDGE_RESPONSE_CAP_BYTES.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_DISCOVER_EXTRA_ROOTS.what: Directories that discover and verify may read besides each client's own roots.
HUB_DISCOVER_EXTRA_ROOTS.change: Only add paths that hold agent config you want imported; the policy floor's denied paths stay denied.
HUB_DISCOVER_EXTRA_ROOTS.accepts: A JSON list of absolute paths.
HUB_DISCOVER_EXTRA_ROOTS.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_INBOX_RATE_PER_MIN.what: Inbox proposals per client per minute until one is saved in Settings > General, which then wins, also after a restart.
HUB_INBOX_RATE_PER_MIN.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_INBOX_MAX_PER_CLIENT.what: Pending inbox proposals per client until one is saved in Settings > General, which then wins, also after a restart.
HUB_INBOX_MAX_PER_CLIENT.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_PLAN_RETENTION.what: Plans kept until one is saved in Settings > General, which then wins, also after a restart.
HUB_PLAN_RETENTION.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_EVAL_GATE.what: The default import gate. A value saved in Settings > General wins over it.
HUB_EVAL_GATE.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_EVAL_GATE_OBSERVED.what: The default gate for skills from a client's observed inventory. A value saved in Settings > General wins over it.
HUB_EVAL_GATE_OBSERVED.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_EVAL_GATE_MIN_TIERS.what: The default weakest evaluation that counts. A value saved in Settings > General wins over it.
HUB_EVAL_GATE_MIN_TIERS.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_ENABLE_METRICS.what: Whether `/metrics` (Prometheus) is served. It needs a key like every API route.
HUB_ENABLE_METRICS.effect: Read once at start: restart the hub after you install the file.

HUB_API_KEY.what: A key for `hubctl`, read from the environment, else from this file. The server does not read it.
HUB_API_KEY.change: A key in a file can be read by every process of your user; the hidden prompt or the bootstrap key file are the alternatives (docs/OPERATIONS.md, Key handling).
HUB_API_KEY.effect: hubctl reads it on each run.

HUB_ALLOW_NONLOOPBACK.what: Allows a non-loopback `HUB_HOST`. Read only from the process environment.
HUB_ALLOW_NONLOOPBACK.change: In this file it has no effect.

HUB_PYTHON.what: The Python the Turnstone adapter's verify uses. Read only from the process environment.
HUB_PYTHON.change: In this file it has no effect; set it with `Environment=` in the unit.

AGENT_HUB_APP_ROOT.what: Where `policy/`, `frontend/` and `deploy/` are, for a binary moved out of `backend/target/`. Read only from the process environment.
AGENT_HUB_APP_ROOT.change: In this file it has no effect.

AGENT_HUB_ENV_FILE.what: Which env file the hub reads. Read only from the process environment.
AGENT_HUB_ENV_FILE.change: In this file it has no effect.

host.what: The address the service listens on.
host.change: Keep loopback. Any other host is refused at start unless the service runs with `--allow-bind-any`, which is for a container on an internal network only.
host.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

port.change: Set the same URL in the hub (`HUB_KNOWLEDGE_URL`).
port.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

allowed_hosts.what: Extra Host header values the service accepts (DNS-rebinding allowlist).
allowed_hosts.change: Add the name a broker or proxy sends, such as `agent-knowledge:8795`.
allowed_hosts.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

allowed_hosts.#.change: Remove it to refuse that Host.
allowed_hosts.#.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

data_dir.what: The service's own state: its database (`knowledge.db`, 0600) and the admin key file (`admin.key`, 0600, written on first start).
data_dir.change: A new path starts with new tokens and a new admin key.
data_dir.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

lance_dir.what: Where the embedded LanceDB tables are stored.
lance_dir.change: Put it on an SSD, never on tmpfs. Moving it without the files loses the lancedb namespaces.
lance_dir.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

qdrant_url.what: The Qdrant server for namespaces with backend `qdrant`. Unset turns that backend off.
qdrant_url.change: Qdrant must enforce an API key (the service refuses a keyless Qdrant).
qdrant_url.accepts: A plain http(s) URL without credentials or query.
qdrant_url.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

qdrant_api_key_env.what: The NAME of the environment variable that holds the Qdrant API key. Never the key itself.
qdrant_api_key_env.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

qdrant_vectors_on_disk.what: Whether new Qdrant collections keep vectors on disk rather than in RAM.
qdrant_vectors_on_disk.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

router_url.what: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint the service calls for `/v1/embeddings` (a LiteLLM router, for example).
router_url.change: Text queries and ingest use it; it must serve the namespace's embedding model.
router_url.accepts: A plain http(s) URL. Unset: `KNOWLEDGE_ROUTER_URL`, else http://127.0.0.1:4000.
router_url.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

router_api_key_env.what: The NAME of the environment variable that holds the embeddings key.
router_api_key_env.change: Use an embeddings-only virtual key, never a master key.
router_api_key_env.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

default_embedding_model.what: The embedding model a new namespace uses when it names none.
default_embedding_model.accepts: A model name your endpoint serves.
default_embedding_model.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

ingest_roots.what: Directories an admin may ingest from with a `path` job.
ingest_roots.change: Empty turns path ingest off; only add trees whose files may be searched.
ingest_roots.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

ingest_roots.#.what: One directory path ingest may read.
ingest_roots.#.change: Remove it to refuse jobs under it.
ingest_roots.#.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

index_roots.what: Directories the shared-index registry may point at.
index_roots.change: Empty means no shared index can be registered.
index_roots.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

index_roots.#.what: One directory the shared-index registry may use.
index_roots.#.change: Remove it to refuse indexes under it.
index_roots.#.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

body_cap_bytes.what: The largest request body the service accepts.
body_cap_bytes.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_docs_per_request.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_doc_chars.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_files_per_job.what: Files one path-ingest job may read.
max_files_per_job.change: The job stops at the limit.
max_files_per_job.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_job_bytes.what: Bytes one path-ingest job may read.
max_job_bytes.change: The job stops at the limit.
max_job_bytes.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_chunks_per_namespace.change: Writes over the cap are refused.
max_chunks_per_namespace.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_k.what: The most results one query may ask for.
max_k.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_filter_nodes.what: The size limit of a query filter.
max_filter_nodes.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

lance_max_scan_rows.what: The largest LanceDB table a filtered query may scan (a `doc_id` filter is exempt).
lance_max_scan_rows.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

store_timeout_s.what: Seconds one store call may take before the caller gets 429 `store_timeout`.
store_timeout_s.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

lance_lock_wait_s.what: Seconds a call waits for a busy LanceDB namespace before 429 `store_busy`.
lance_lock_wait_s.change: Raise it for heavy concurrent writes.
lance_lock_wait_s.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

lance_workers.change: More threads, more parallel store calls.
lance_workers.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_query_chars.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

max_jobs_kept.what: Finished ingest jobs kept for their status.
max_jobs_kept.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

embed_batch.what: Texts sent to the embeddings endpoint per call.
embed_batch.change: Lower it if the endpoint refuses large batches.
embed_batch.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

default_rate_per_min.what: Requests per minute for a token created without its own rate.
default_rate_per_min.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

default_daily_queries.what: Queries per day for a token created without its own quota.
default_daily_queries.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

default_daily_writes.what: Chunks a write token may upsert per day, when created without its own quota.
default_daily_writes.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

sse_max_seconds.what: The longest an ingest-progress stream stays open.
sse_max_seconds.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

sse_max_streams.effect: Read once at start: restart the knowledge service.

id.what: The client's id; the file must be named `<id>.yaml`. Also the name in plans, profiles and the audit log.
id.change: A new id is a new client: the old one keeps its profile and history.
id.accepts: Lower-case letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`; 1 to 64 characters; `hub` is reserved.
id.effect: When the file is committed in the content repo.

adapter.what: Which adapter renders this client's files: `generic` (driven by `spec:`) or a built-in one (claude-code, opencode, hermes-agent, turnstone, deepseek-harness).
adapter.change: Another adapter writes other files in other places; review the plan carefully.
adapter.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

display_name.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

description.what: A sentence the UI shows under the name.
description.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

strict.what: Whether anything the client cannot express is an error that blocks apply.
strict.change: `false` turns those into warnings, so a plan can apply with parts left out.
strict.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

roots.what: Named delivery roots: the directories this client's files go to. The spec and the adapter refer to them by name (`project`, `home`, ...).
roots.change: A root may not be your home directory itself, `/`, or overlap the hub's own state or content.
roots.accepts: A mapping of name to path; `~` is expanded.
roots.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

roots.*.change: Files under the old path are not moved or removed; the next plan targets the new path.
roots.*.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

manage.what: Which concerns the hub manages for this client: `skills`, `agents`, `instructions`, `mcp`, `permissions`, `memory`.
manage.change: A concern set to `false` is left alone (advisory only).
manage.default: skills, agents, instructions on; mcp, permissions, memory off
manage.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

manage.*.what: Whether the hub manages this concern for the client.
manage.*.change: Turning it on makes the next plan deliver it; turning it off stops managing those files (they stay where they are).
manage.*.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

params.what: Adapter-specific settings (for example a container name for a staged delivery).
params.change: Read the adapter's section in docs/OPERATIONS.md first.
params.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

params.**.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

icon.what: An icon name the UI may show.

color.what: A colour the UI may show.

spec.what: The declarative delivery layout of a `generic` client: where each concern goes and in which format (docs/ADDING-A-CLIENT.md).
spec.change: Every section is optional; a concern without one is reported as unsupported.
spec.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.version.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.notes.what: Free text for the people who read the spec.
spec.notes.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.tool_map.what: Canonical capability to the client's native tool name (`read`, `write`, `shell`, ...). `null` marks a capability unsupported.
spec.tool_map.change: Agents' tool lists are translated with it.
spec.tool_map.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.tool_map.*.what: The native tool name for one capability, or `null`.
spec.tool_map.*.change: Changes how agents' tools are written.
spec.tool_map.*.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.model_tiers.what: Model tier (`fast`, `standard`, `deep`) to the client's model id.
spec.model_tiers.change: Agents' model lines are written with it.
spec.model_tiers.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.model_tiers.*.what: The client's model id for one tier.
spec.model_tiers.*.change: Changes the model agents of that tier use.
spec.model_tiers.*.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.skills.change: Changes the folder skills are delivered to.
spec.skills.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.agents.what: Where subagents go and how they are written: `root`, `path`, `filename` (needs `{name}`), `format` (`md_frontmatter`, `json`, `yaml`), `fields`, `static`, `tools_field`, `tools_format`, `model_field`.
spec.agents.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.instructions.change: `block` replaces only the hub's marker region, so hand-written text survives; `own` and `concat` own the whole file.
spec.instructions.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.instructions.mode.what: How instructions are written into the file.
spec.instructions.mode.change: `block`: only the hub's marker region. `own`: the whole file, with headings. `concat`: the whole file, bodies joined.
spec.instructions.mode.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.mcp.what: Where MCP servers go: `root`, `file`, `format` (`json`, `yaml`, `toml`), `key_path`, `entry` templates per transport, `env_style`, `wrapper`.
spec.mcp.change: JSON and YAML are key-merged (other keys in the file are kept); TOML is a marker block.
spec.mcp.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.mcp.format.change: Changes how the servers are merged into the file.
spec.mcp.format.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.mcp.env_style.what: How environment variables are written: `dollar_brace` (`${NAME}`), `env_ref`, or `names_only`. Values never enter the hub.
spec.mcp.env_style.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.permissions.what: Where permission rules go: `root`, `file`, `format`, `lists` (decision to key path), `rule_templates`.
spec.permissions.change: Only the listed keys are the hub's; the rest of the file is kept.
spec.permissions.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.memory.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.*.root.what: The named root (from `roots:`) this section writes under.
spec.*.root.change: Must name a root of this client.
spec.*.root.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.*.file.what: The file this section writes, relative to its root.
spec.*.file.change: Relative paths only; `..` and absolute paths are refused.
spec.*.file.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.*.path.what: The folder this section writes into, relative to its root.
spec.*.path.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

spec.**.what: Part of the generic spec (docs/ADDING-A-CLIENT.md has the full reference).
spec.**.change: Check the draft: errors name their exact path, such as `spec.skills.layoutt: unknown key`.
spec.**.effect: The next plan and apply use it; files already delivered change only when you apply again.

version.effect: Never through the hub: change policy/floor.yaml in git, with review, then restart the hub (it is loaded at start and refuses to start if it is invalid).

network_default.what: The default for network egress: content can only add explicit `egress_host` allow rules for named hosts.
